criteria.text: The shore exit works without the boat (walk there on dry land)
Fuel goes down once: exactly the engine's burn for 10 s at full throttle
Battery charge goes down once per sonar ping (and the buoy logs it)
The creature under the water homes in on engine vibration, and loses interest when the engine stops
A flat battery switches off only what it powers (sonar, GPS); torch, paper map and engine still work
The generator recharges the battery and the sonar works again
In deep water breath runs down, you soak and chill, and harm comes only through health (drowning, cold)
Every scripted fault has a visible cause and a way to recover (and the hut warms you)

faults: battery-flat: Battery flat: the sonar and GPS are off / Charge it at the station generator, or navigate by the paper map
out-of-fuel: Out of fuel: the engine coughs and dies / Paddle back to the dock (slow), or refuel at the station
in-the-water: You're in deep, cold water: breath and warmth are going / Get to the shallows or the dock; the heated hut on the west shore is the recovery point

criteria.text: Data survives only as a valid copy (copied readings come home; uncopied ones are lost)
Storm variant: more fuel per second and the boat is pushed downwind

detail.reason: run with &storm to evaluate (the check does both)
